newsitem.title: THAILAND: Trade in Natural Park halted, debt woes.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Natural Park halted, debt woes.

text.p: The Thai stock exchange halted trading Friday in stocks of property developer Natural Park Plc after the firm said it was holding talks with financial advisers over its inability to pay interest due on some of its bonds.

The exchange said it was seeking clarification from the company. Natural Park said separately that it had not been able to pay interest on some of its unsecured debentures due on May 20 due to side-effects from a slowing national economy.

Natural Park said it was holding talks with its financial advisers, including Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc and Ekachart Finance and Securities Plc, on ways to solve the problem in order to cause a minumum impact on its bond holders.

Natural Park issued two billion baht in unsecured debentures valued at 1,000 baht each on May 20, 1994. The bond, due to mature in 1999, carries interest payment every six months -- on May 20 and November 20.
The company said it would inform the bourse immediately after a solution was found.
